title: 기술심리관규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text: Article 6 (Request for Dispatch) When requesting a government agency responsible for patents or related matters to dispatch a public official under its jurisdiction, the reasons for dispatch, the period of dispatch, the qualifications required of the official to be dispatched, and other necessary matters shall be specified.
